author: Rubric Labs
description: Switch between your own Codex, Claude Code and Grok accounts from one local dashboard, with live token analytics.
name: tokenmaxx

scripts.build: bun run clean && bun build ./src/index.ts --target bun --outdir dist --external '@opentui/*' && cp bin/launcher.cjs dist/launcher.cjs && chmod 755 dist/index.js dist/launcher.cjs
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun x biome check . && bun test
scripts.gui:dev: bun run build:bin && TOKENMAXX_BIN=gui/target/bin/tokenmaxx cargo run --manifest-path gui/Cargo.toml
